name: tracksy-monorepo
description: TRACKSY - Smart Student Transport Tracking System - Monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd studentapp && npm install && cd ../admin-dashboard && npm install && cd ../driver-app && npm install
scripts.web: concurrently --names "🚀LAUNCHER,📊ADMIN,👨‍🎓STUDENT,🚗DRIVER" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green,yellow" --prefix "[{name}]" --kill-others "npm run launcher:web" "npm run admin:web" "npm run student:web" "npm run driver:web"
scripts.web:clean: concurrently --names "🚀LAUNCHER,📊ADMIN,👨‍🎓STUDENT,🚗DRIVER" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green,yellow" --prefix "[{name}]" --kill-others "npm run launcher:web" "npm run admin:web" "cd studentapp && EXPO_OFFLINE=1 npx expo start --web --clear --port 19007" "cd driver-app && EXPO_OFFLINE=1 npx expo start --web --clear --port 19008"

author: TRACKSY Team
